starterGuidePolicy.purpose: A useful source-led starting guide with individually relevant credited imagery; not exhaustive research or community endorsement.
starterGuidePolicy.sourceSelection: Prefer a few excellent actual-content works and community voices with reliable primary/scholarly context. Larger umbrellas may need more; smaller communities may have less public material. Never pad counts.
starterGuidePolicy.legacyMetrics: The existing twelve-source filters and historical comparison fields remain quantity measures only, not current targets or gates.
starterGuidePolicy.images: Actual rights-cleared and individually relevant card/profile pictures with visible credits, source, reuse and copying/inspection notes.

researchPriority: Substantive research and credited directory imagery: Texas, Idaho, Minnesota, Blackfeet Tribe Montana, then Michigan; verified individual community outlines added alongside
